name: EU Single Market Established
summary: The European Single Market came into effect, allowing free movement of goods, services, capital, and people.

name: Bill Clinton Inaugurated
summary: Bill Clinton was sworn in as the 42nd President of the United States.

name: Waco Siege Ends
summary: A 51-day standoff between federal agents and a religious group ended in a deadly fire.

name: Oslo Accords Signed
summary: Israel and the PLO signed agreements aimed at achieving peace.

name: World Trade Center Bombing
summary: A truck bomb exploded beneath the World Trade Center, killing six people.

name: Czechoslovakia Dissolution
summary: Czechoslovakia peacefully split into two independent countries.
